title: Semantics of the Equal-Register Branch
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input, guard $G$, and probability $p$. Suppose its instruction at control state $l$ branches to $l_1$ when registers $r$ and $s$ are equal and to $l_0$ otherwise. If the current configuration satisfies $G$, the two registers have equal values, and the configuration at $l_1$ with the register assignment unchanged has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$, then the current configuration has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$.
